title: EventEnvelope
description: Every Kafka message value is one envelope serialized as UTF-8 JSON. Event schemas extend it with allOf and pin eventType and payload.

eventId.description: Unique per event; consumers dedupe on (eventId, consumer) in processed_events

schemaVersion.description: Version of the payload schema for this eventType

correlationId.description: Starts at the upload request and is copied unchanged to every event caused by it (also sent as Kafka header 'correlationId')
